lesson_text: For equality against unknown Python objects, inspect whether conversion falls back to parsing their textual representation. Test strict conversion with explicit comparison cases and report any changed test expectations separately from source behavior.

When debugging equality between numeric zero and symbolic booleans, inspect type guards before truthiness shortcuts and test both operand orders. Preserve numeric-zero compatibility with separate control cases.

When handling empty EXISTS subqueries, preserve the distinction between positive and negated EXISTS and keep other WHERE predicates intact. Treat backend-specific boolean SQL branches separately; the shown SQL smoke check uses SQLite.
When supporting pandas nullable label dtypes, inspect both target-type inference and label extraction. Keep missing-value handling separate from the demonstrated non-missing binary-label cases.

When extending inverse-trigonometric LaTeX formatting, inspect the function-name dispatch table and test each added function with the requested style. The observed acsc output comes from agent-edited code, not a source-revision check.

When diagnosing dtype warnings for DataFrames, inspect column dtypes as well as scalar dtype metadata. Compare baseline and edited test failures by identity and cause; matching failure totals alone do not establish regression equivalence.

For mpmath lambdify rational constants, inspect generated source for mpf conversion before division; verify high-precision numerical behavior separately. Use the repository test runner when pytest is unavailable.

Distinguish raw fixture saves from normal explicit-primary-key saves when changing the default-primary-key INSERT shortcut. A raw-only guard does not demonstrate that normal save behavior was fixed; retain separate reproduction cases.

When debugging presentation MathML for scripted symbol names, inspect the emitted XML tree and distinguish it from content MathML. Check browser rendering separately; changing a serializer tree does not by itself prove the reported browser symptom is fixed.

When debugging only() with reverse select_related(), compare the field-object keys used by mask construction and mask lookup. Keep original-test results separate from results obtained after changing expectations, and preserve replay state when submitted patches omit test edits.

When expanding related-model Meta.ordering, distinguish expression objects from string field paths before calling string-oriented ordering helpers. Check direction handling separately for existing OrderBy objects.

When investigating GROUP BY ambiguity with a Subquery annotation, inspect how annotation aliases are passed to get_group_by_cols and whether they collide with joined-table columns. Do not treat unrelated suite success as reproduction of the PostgreSQL issue.

For Python Indexed printing, inspect the printer hierarchy before placing the handler in a shared base class. Check one- and multi-index expressions explicitly; the recorded smoke checks do not establish behavior for every backend.

When changing timezone SQL handling, distinguish named zones containing signs from numeric offsets and test parsing behavior in the actual Python environment. Do not assume a helper recalled from a later Django version exists at the source revision; preserve the complete submitted patch.

When embedding a condition in CASE WHEN, handle the empty-SQL representation of a match-all WHERE condition explicitly. Test backend-specific boolean rendering and preserve the distinction from a condition that matches nothing.

When replacing Django HTML escaping with a standard-library implementation, inspect exact entity spelling and dependent unescaping code. Separate expected textual-output changes from unrelated test errors, and specify UTF-8 when editing non-ASCII source in an ASCII-locale environment.
